layout.hierarchy: The red two-line title utterly dominates (largest element by far, bold, saturated red on pale gray). Second most visible is the black bottom bar; the thin red border is subtle; the cursor is nearly negligible.

visual_elements.description: Thin rectangular border/frame outlining the slide content area on the top, left, and right sides; it runs down behind/into the black bottom bar. Border thickness ~1-2 px.
visual_elements.position: inset frame: ~6% from left, ~7% from top, ~93% right edge, extending to bottom bar

visual_elements.position: bottom edge, full width, ~5% of image height

imagery: No photographs, illustrations, or decorative icons. Only artifact-level imagery: a black mouse cursor arrow in the lower-center area and the black letterboxing bar at the bottom.
typography_notes: Single text element: a very large, heavy-weight sans-serif title (Arial/Helvetica-Bold-like), not italic, not all-caps, in dark red. It is center-aligned and wraps onto two lines: '[1] Revision of' / 'Machine Learning'. Title size is roughly 54-66 pt equivalent, occupying about 55% of the slide width per line. No body text, no bullet markers, no numbering beyond the literal '[1]' inside the title string.
animation_state: No build state visible; this is a static section-title slide. Nothing appears mid-animation. The presence of the mouse cursor indicates this is a frame from a screen-recorded video.
recreation_brief: 1. Create a new PowerPoint slide with a blank layout. 2. Set the slide background fill to light gray, approx hex #E9E9E7. 3. Draw a rectangle with no fill and a thin (~1 pt) dark-red (#B01E23) outline, positioned from about 6% of slide width on the left to 93% on the right, and from about 7% of slide height at the top down to the bottom edge of the slide; this is the border frame. 4. Insert a text box centered horizontally, spanning roughly 15%-85% of slide width, with its vertical center around 42% of slide height. 5. Type the title exactly as: [1] Revision of Machine Learning — set it to a bold sans-serif font (e.g., Arial Bold), font size ~60 pt, font color dark red #B01E23, center-aligned, and let it wrap into two lines so it reads '[1] Revision of' on line 1 and 'Machine Learning' on line 2 (insert a manual line break after 'of' if needed). 6. Do not add any bullets, subtitles, footers, slide numbers, or images. 7. Leave the lower ~40% of the slide empty. 8. Optional, only if replicating the video frame exactly: add a full-width solid black (#000000) rectangle ~5% of slide height at the very bottom edge (this is video letterboxing, not slide content), and optionally place a small black arrow-cursor icon at ~57% width / ~73% height. 9. Save; the slide should show only the red-framed gray canvas with the large centered red two-line title.
